'''Cha''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rellarin]] in the service of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. By circa [[3643 BBY]], he had ascended to the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Major/Legends|major]]. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] the same [[Standard year/Legends|year]] during [[Independent Operation Sebaddon]].
